newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet H1 profits climb, debt tumbles. [Corrected 15:56 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Stet H1 profits climb, debt tumbles. [Corrected 15:56 gmt]

text.p: Net debt servicing cost 502 vs 1,479 (end Dec)
Note: State controlled telecom's holding Stet SpA, slated for privatisation next year, said it expected its full year 1996 results would be "in line" with 1995 results.

Note: Stet said that while at the SpA, parent company level, results in 1996 would be in line with 1995 results, at the group level it expected a "significantly" better performance this year than last year.
Number of employees 132,194 people vs 132,548 (end Dec)
Note: Stet said its parent and group pre-tax profit figure was boosted by a 372 billion lire one-off gain from the sale of 40 percent of Italtel to Siemens AG.

It said it expected consolidated turnover for the whole year to total around 40 trillion lire from 37.37 trillion lire in 1995. It said it expected investments this year to be well in excess of 1995's 9.07 trillion lire.
It added that it would spend some 35.5 trillion lire on investments between 1997 and 1999.
